notes: Two sayings from one head (rule 4a): saying 1 is Ibn Abbas's ruling to the people of Madina (قال لهم تنفر); saying 2 is the report of Umm Sulaym's hadith of Safiyya (فكان فيمن سألوا أم سليم، فذكرت حديث صفية).
The people of Madina (سألوا) are in the scene and are not a link. The Safiyya saying is attached to Ikrima directly, since the text gives no other transmitter.
«رواه خالد وقتادة عن عكرمة» names other transmitters for the Safiyya saying, so it is a variant group (rule 4).
